media.title: Let's Talk Agentic Development: Spotify and Anthropic

title: Let’s Talk Agentic Development: Spotify × Anthropic
summary: Leaders from Spotify and Anthropic discuss background agents, context engineering, feedback loops, governance, and accountability as agent-generated output grows. They emphasize outcome ownership and describe the next frontier as agents participating across maintenance, deletion, and the full software lifecycle rather than only creating features.
takeaway: Assign a named human owner to every agent task and define the acceptance evidence up front—tests, screenshots, performance checks, or deletion criteria—before using agents for ongoing maintenance.
